response.sql: WITH pa AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS overall FROM pa), ab AS (SELECT pa.pattern, pa.avg_igg, o.overall FROM pa, o WHERE pa.avg_igg > o.overall) SELECT pattern, avg_igg, avg_igg - overall AS above_overall_avg, avg_igg - (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) FROM ab) AS diff_from_above_avg_mean FROM ab ORDER BY avg_igg DESC
